title: Purportedly AI-Generated Impersonation of Actor Ioan Gruffudd Allegedly Convinced a Fan They Had a Romantic Relationship
summary: An impersonator allegedly used AI-generated images and videos of Welsh actor Ioan Gruffudd to convince a woman she was in a relationship with him for more than a year. Contact reportedly began through an Elsbeth Facebook page and continued on Telegram. Gruffudd described the material as explicit and disturbing, warned fans, and said he reported the matter to police. He clarified that no money had been requested or sent.
